description: This file is a unit test source file for the NetworkManager plugin in a software project. It uses Google Test framework to test various aspects of the NetworkManager, such as interface configuration, WPS, WiFi states, IP settings, and configuration endpoints. The file includes mock objects for external dependencies and verifies that the plugin's public methods and RPC handlers behave as expected under different conditions.
